title: Blood Donation Camp
summary: Rotary Club of Mumbai Mahim organised Blood Donation Drive in October 2026, at NJ Wealth, Dadar, on 14th October with the support of Tata Memorial Hospital staff in managing the camps.
description:
Rotary Club of Mumbai Mahim organised Blood Donation Drive in October 2026, at NJ Wealth,
Dadar, on 14th October with the support of Tata Memorial Hospital staff in managing the camps.
The drives received a response, with 15 donors at the camp
location: NJ Wealth office, Dadar (East), Mumbai, Maharashtra
